comparison.objective: Replenish line-side bins according to min/max labels; candidate tunes and locks a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Label reading, quantity reasoning, and bin replenishment versus fine tool insertion, counterholding, rotary tuning, locking, and repeated test cycles.
comparison.success_condition: Bin quantities comply with min/max labels versus two safe dynamic stops with no drift. PR lacks detailed quantity and failure thresholds.
comparison.reason: Inventory replenishment does not test mechanical commissioning.
